title_as_printed: Temperature, pressure and NaCl content of vapors and liquid in equilibrium with liquid NaCl solutions near the critical temperature of water.
property_description: NaCl content (printed %NaCl, presumably weight percent; the paper never says weight or mole) of the vapor sampled from the top of the vessel at pressures on the vapor side of the two-phase boundary; rows marked * (note column) are the liquid composition (starting liquid), not the vapor
pressure_note: not stated whether gauge or absolute; pressure measured with transducers on the vessel; given in bars; sampling lowered the pressure along the phase boundary

composition.other_species: binary NaCl-H2O; the measured quantity is the NaCl content of the coexisting vapor (or the liquid on * rows); starting liquid composition is given in the block label rows (0.1, 9.2, 8.8 %NaCl by weight)

skip_rows.reason: block label row (isotherm and starting liquid)

conversion_needs: %NaCl basis (weight presumably; abstract says '% NaCl' and the starting solutions 'by weight') to mole fraction or molality needs the basis confirmed
notes: Four side-by-side blocks (A left, A right, B left, B right) stacked in that order. Rows marked * are liquid compositions (the first sample of each starting liquid) and are kept; they are not vapor values. Rows are in sampling order as printed.
